name: recipe-sender
description: Turn a recipe written in ChatGPT into a Cookidoo® link with guided cooking steps for your Thermomix®. Preview the card, confirm, and save the recipe to your own Cookidoo account. Planning your week? One confirmation sends the whole plan, up to 6 recipes, to Cookidoo. Unofficial: not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Vorwerk. Thermomix® and Cookidoo® are trademarks of Vorwerk.

interface.longDescription:
Ask ChatGPT for a recipe for your Thermomix® and get a Cookidoo® link you can save to your own account, with the guided cooking steps already set.

How it works: ask for a dish, or paste a recipe of your own. ChatGPT writes it in Thermomix style and shows it as a card with the ingredients, the steps, and each machine setting highlighted: time, speed, temperature, reverse, and the dough, turbo, browning and steaming modes. An ingredient named in a step is highlighted too, with its amount next to it. The card speaks the language of your conversation: English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Polish or Portuguese. Ask for any change.

Missing an ingredient for a Cookidoo recipe? Give ChatGPT its Cookidoo link and say what to change. The plugin reads the official recipe and ChatGPT changes only that.

The card says which country's Cookidoo site the recipe will be sent to. That country comes from the approximate location ChatGPT shares with the plugin, so you are not asked for it. If your Cookidoo account is registered in a different country, tell ChatGPT before sending. ChatGPT asks for the country only when it has no location to go by.

When you say yes, or press Send to Cookidoo on the card, the recipe is created on the Cookidoo site of that country and the card shows the link. Open the link while signed into Cookidoo, choose Add to Created recipes, and it is in your account ready for guided cooking: each step with its time, speed, temperature and mode, the ingredients linked to their steps with their amounts, and a cover photo.

Planning your week? Ask for a meal plan of up to 6 recipes, each with a day. ChatGPT lists the plan and asks once, and one yes sends the whole week to Cookidoo, with one card holding every link. Save each recipe, then add it to a day of your Cookidoo week from its menu.

You never give us your Cookidoo or Vorwerk login. The recipe is created under the plugin's own Cookidoo account and shared by link.

Who it is for: Thermomix owners with a Cookidoo account who want to cook ChatGPT's ideas or family recipes with guided settings instead of typing them in by hand.

Limitations: sending works for Cookidoo accounts registered in Germany, France, Poland, the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, and the countries of Cookidoo's international site (cookidoo.international), such as Chile, Brazil and Sweden. The current list is at https://cook.bygmv.com/terms. For any other country the card shows the recipe without a Send button and says that sending is not available there yet. A link only opens for accounts on the same Cookidoo country site, so check the country on the card before you send. Temperatures show in °F for United States accounts and in °C elsewhere. You need your own Cookidoo account to open and save a recipe. A sent recipe is public: anyone who has the link can open it, Cookidoo shows it as shared by the community, and you cannot edit or remove the shared original, only your saved copy. Do not put personal information in a recipe. Send only recipes ChatGPT wrote, your own, or an official Cookidoo recipe you changed through the plugin, not recipes copied from websites or books. A recipe holds up to 40 ingredients and 30 steps. The plugin limits how many recipes it sends per minute and per day, so a send can ask you to wait. Settings are written by ChatGPT and can contain mistakes: check times, speeds and temperatures before you cook. The cover photo is generated by AI from a short English description of the finished dish, or else from the recipe name and its main ingredients, which are sent to an image generation provider named on the privacy page, so it is an illustration and may not match the dish exactly. If the photo cannot be generated, the recipe is sent without one. The plugin keeps no recipe and no photo on its own server.

Unofficial: not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Vorwerk. Thermomix® and Cookidoo® are trademarks of Vorwerk.
